$schema_note: Plain JSON, not a W3C design-token file. Every value cites its source. px = rendered CSS px; desktop 1440x900, mobile 390x844, tablet 834 (clamp evaluated).

status_values.observed: value read from computed styles of a harvested page
status_values.css-only: from CSS for a screen not publicly reachable (reader, start flow, hearth, create)

metrics_em.note: lowercase glyphs are small capitals; no descenders except capital J

wordmark.role: wordmark and book titles; always uppercase

serif.italic: none loaded: font-style italic is synthesised (oblique)
serif.role: reading text: ledes, body copy, captions, legal prose, story prose, story choices

ui.resolved: "Schibsted Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk Fallback", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
ui.role: interface: body default, buttons, chips, labels, nav, forms, footer

weightResolution.Lora: declared 600 & 700 -> any request <=600 draws 600, >=700 draws 700 (Lora 400/500 are unreachable)
weightResolution.Source Serif 4: declared 400 & 600 -> <=500 draws 400, >=600 draws 600 (bold 700 links/strong draw at 600)
weightResolution.Cinzel: static Bold file, every request draws the one Bold face

accent-span.note: flat colour, not gradient text; the trailing full stop stays in --page-ink

h1.handoff.note: .start-flow .handoff h1 overrides only size and margin

letterSpacing.rule: negative tracking on Lora headings (tighter as they grow); zero on Cinzel titles (the logo is the exception at 3px); positive tracking only on UPPERCASE Grotesk/Cinzel micro-labels

lineHeights.normal: most Lora headings below h1 and all UI labels (Lora normal = 1.28 em, Grotesk normal = 1.234 em)

grad.note: name suggests gradient text but it is a flat colour; no background-clip:text anywhere in the CSS

treatments.syntheticItalic: Source Serif 4 italic is never loaded; all font-style:italic text is a browser-slanted roman

canvasText.where: story-title labels on the logs of the waiting-fire canvas

treatments.nextErrorPage: Next.js built-in error UI uses system-ui 24px/32px 500 -0.02em and ui-monospace 12px (source/js/36s0t0o8ux5as.js) — not part of the brand

diacritics.coverage: all in the preloaded latin subset of every family
diacritics.quotes: dialogue and titles use ASCII " and ' (e.g. från "Alva och fyraljuset"), not Swedish ” ” ; comma placed outside the closing quote ("…", sa han.)
